messages:
Nora (AE): quick sync - bank wants an air-gapped POC next month. Requirements: USB-only delivery, max media 4.5GB, strict no-telemetry, quarterly security review. They also asked for an approval token flow for upgrades. Can engineering/infosec confirm feasibility? cc @Ethan @Maya

Ethan (SE): feasible but a few constraints. Two delivery patterns:
- chunked installer (streaming apply from USB) to hit 4.5GB cap
- full image on larger media (simpler)

Ethan (SE): chunked approach implications:
- operator must support resume and chunk verification (checksums per-chunk)
- manifests grow slightly in complexity (chunk table + sequence)
- applying many small patches increases apply-time verification overhead

Ethan (SE): example chunk manifest snippet:
```yaml
manifest_version: 1
chunks:
  - name: pkg.part01
    size: 104857600
    sha256: a1b2...
  - name: pkg.part02
    size: 104857600
    sha256: c3d4...
signing: sig-v2
```

Jordan (Customer): security questionnaire demand: must use FIPS-validated crypto and show chain-of-custody for images. Can you support HSM-signed bundles and auditable signing logs?

Maya (Security): yes. We provide a signing CLI that supports PKCS#11 HSMs. For chain-of-custody: we can emit a signing log artifact (timestamped entries, signer key id, bundle digest). We recommend they keep signed-manifest + signing-log on the USB.

Maya (Security): telemetry/telemetry off: by default our air-gap operator disables all outbound telemetry. If they want internal metrics, we can collect to a local syslog endpoint only.

Ben (Solutions): commercial: POC package options:
- Standard POC (bundle gen + 3d eng support) = $10k one-time
- Tight-delivery POC (chunked media engineering + 7d onsite/remote) = $22k one-time
Both include SBOM generation and a brief security handoff runbook.

Nora (AE): procurement note - Jordan, do you have locked PO windows? We might need signoff 2 weeks before delivery to allow image signing and QA.

Jordan (Customer): procurement closes on the 15th. Also compliance insists that any upgrade must be manually approved by an authorized admin. Auto-install is not allowed.

Ethan (SE): operator upgrade UX: staged-download -> pending state -> requires an approval token. We support two approval token methods:
1) Admin signs a small token file with their private key (PKCS#11 or file-based). Operator verifies signature and applies.
2) A short-lived signed activation code generated by the customer's offline CA (we can validate chain).

Ethan (SE): sample approval token flow (CLI):
```bash
# customer side: sign approval
approval.json: {"bundle_digest":"sha256:abcd...","requested_by":"ops@bank.local","timestamp":"2024-07-10T10:00:00Z"}
pkcs11_sign --key 01 --in approval.json --out approval.sig
# operator: verify and apply
operator verify-approval --token approval.json --sig approval.sig --pubkey admin_pub.pem && operator apply
```

Maya (Security): one compliance caveat: approval tokens must include a nonce and timestamp and operator should reject tokens older than N minutes (configurable). We'll recommend a 24-hour max age for manual approvals in their policy.

Ben (Solutions): SOW notes: include 2 retests if initial USB install fails in lab. Additional on-site remediation billed at daily rates. Also propose including a short runbook for auditors showing verification steps.

Infra-bot: reminder scheduled for 2024-07-08 08:30 to review chunked-installer QA checklist. :bell:

Jordan (Customer): one more ask: can the signing key be rotated by us post-delivery while keeping old bundles verifiable? We need revocation semantics.

Maya (Security): yes. Operator supports a keyring with multiple public keys and key-id-based verification. We support a simple 'revoked_keys' list. We also provide a revocation log format they'd drop on USB to indicate key retirement.

Ethan (SE): next technical deliverables:
- quick POC design doc: chunked image layout + approval flow (EOD Tue)
- verification scripts for auditors (sha checks + signature checks) (EOD Tue)

Ben (Solutions): I'll put together two quote options and a short SOW and attach a sample invoice. (Email to Jordan)

Nora (AE): action items recap:
- Ethan: POC design + scripts by Tue
- Maya: sample signing log + revocation example by Tue
- Ben: quotes + SOW by Mon EOD
- Jordan: confirm procurement cutoff date (15th) and whether an internal CA will be used for approval tokens

Jordan (Customer): confirmed procurement deadline 15th. We'll confirm CA vs HSM by EOD Mon. Thanks all.
